title: Alternatives + upload feedback — SYNTHETIC DEMO
checks: Size/count limits are visible beside narration, music and source upload controls
Real throttled XHR upload reports an intermediate byte-based percentage and transferred sizes, not a timer
100% transfer is followed by a distinct processing state; completion waits for server metadata processing
A missing S03 main automatically resolves to guide-permitted S01, with zero final sign-offs and no primary-file demand
Per-placement Automatic/Main/Alternative selector obeys the user and shows the alternative’s own label
Review checkboxes have plain-language purposes and explicitly state that they are not required for inspection
Client rejects an oversized selection before sending any upload request, with a clear size-limit error
Client rejects a 31-file batch before upload; limits are per file and per batch, not hidden
Inspection timeline displays the permitted replacement with its own label, not a gap or the missing source’s event label
Mobile: upload/help/choice layout has no horizontal overflow and backup remains reachable
actual_user_guide: Latest 44-placement guide not yet supplied; exact two missing sources are not claimed resolved.
